title: Oral Histories Korean War Veteran Carl House : CSPAN3 : August 3, 2020 8:00pm-8:58pm EDT
summary: The Korean War began on June 25, 1950 and ended with an armistice agreement about three years later in July 1953. Korean War veteran Carl House recounted his part in the amphibious landing at Inchon, a victory for U.N. forces which turned the tide early in the war, and talked about the surprise Chinese counterattack and intense combat at the Battle of Chosin Reservoir where he was captured.
